content.comment_body: Hello! I am a student currently working with [product_name] controllers. We want to experiment with an expansion module together with the base [product_name]. Both the base module and the expansion DM8 24R are 24V and powered. They're installed on a DIN rail and the connector is properly inserted. However, the run/stop light on the expansion module always stays red, and it doesn't seem to function. I also haven't found any guides or instructions for programming the module. I'm using [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], but as a beginner I don't see any specific information about expansion modules. Most online videos just show connecting the expansion, and it works immediately. What am I missing? Any guidance would be appreciated!
If the RUN/STOP LED on the expansion module remains solid red, it likely means the bus connector (slider) has not been pushed fully to the left.

We currently have two setups with the same issue, so I'm doubtful it's a connection problem. I'll double-check on Monday. I attached a link to a photo showing the slider is fully to the left and securely connected to the base module. It can't be moved further.

Your screenshot indicates you're trying to use an older expansion module with a newer base module. Expansion modules with order numbers ending in [article_no] or [article_no] are not compatible with base modules ending in [article_no]. Only expansion modules with order numbers ending in [article_no] will work with that base module. The housing color can also help distinguish them: older modules are dark gray and newer modules are light gray. See the attached screenshot.
Pay attention to the order numbers for compatibility.
That appears to be an older expansion module, which isn't compatible. You might need to advise your university to obtain expansion modules that match the base module.
Have you read my previous posts? I've explained the order number of the compatible module above.

analysis.insight_summary: Users faced issues when trying to use a [product_name] DM8 24R expansion module with a [product_name] base module, encountering a persistent red RUN/STOP LED and lack of response. The main user experience problem stemmed from confusion over module compatibility and limited instructions or guidance within [product_name] Soft Comfort [version_no], especially for those new to the software. Finding reliable tutorials or documentation was difficult, and key markers such as module housing color and order numbers that indicate compatibility were not immediately noticed.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple integration of expansion modules with the base controller, clear instructions within the software to help configure expansion modules, and easy-to-access resources for setup and troubleshooting.
